description: Public placeholder parsing preserves percent vector values, rejects mixed initializer types and validates UTF-8 continuation bytes and escapes.

mutants.description: Preserve the cloned vector length but replace its numeric values with zero; literal content equality fails without an empty-vector exception.
An initializer mixing boolean and numeric expressions must report the dedicated type error before constructing a boolean vector.
Remove validation of an early continuation byte in a three-byte sequence. The malformed E2 28 A1 literal is then accepted and fails the expected-error assertion; valid UTF-8 controls remain accepted.
Unknown backslash escapes must remain rejected by the public string literal parser rather than being copied through as ordinary characters.
